query: SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status, rating, notes, incumbent FROM house_races WHERE (state_code = 'CA' AND district >= 44) OR state_code IN ('IA','MT','NJ','NM','SD') ORDER BY state_code, district;
